manifest_row.title: Palm oil titan warns EU limits on biofuel use will backfire

screening.main_topic: The palm-oil industry’s response to EU limits on palm oil use in biofuel and the economic effects of those limits.
screening.climate_relevance: The article reports that the EU justifies restrictions partly on the grounds that palm oil contributes to deforestation and climate change, while producing nations dispute those claims. Biofuel policy is also discussed, but climate change is not the article’s main focus.
screening.reason: The central emphasis is the business and trade dispute, including growers’ incomes, supply, and palm-oil prices. Climate-related arguments form meaningful context for the policy dispute, making the text relevant as peripheral discourse rather than core climate coverage.
